details: Forum report: NewChirp sees the USB serial port but Read from radio fails after ~1 s. Stock CHIRP alinco_dr735t driver skips the OEM AL~ wake, accepts only DR735TN/TE, uses the bridge's 0.25 s timeout (OEM 500 ms) and calls exit(1) on a short block. Reverse engineering DR-735 Memory Editor 0.06 for a full override.
summary: DR-735T read fails after about one second on MX Linux
